row.title: THOUGHT-1: every white paper becomes per-channel posts that carry the Ultrastable hook
row.body: Papers test common beliefs about AI limits against the system's own records; posts carry belief, measured record and the hook (Ultrastable runs on Ultrastable; Practical Solutions is one system it runs). LinkedIn gets papers only.
